definitions.code_auto_rate: AUTO_SAME pairs / candidate pairs that survive code vetoes
definitions.llm_call_rate: pairs sent to LLM (non-AUTO, non-veto LLM_REVIEW queue) / same candidate set; v1 = all of them
definitions.misintegration_risk: AUTO pairs with hard NOT_SAME (and soft: +UNSURE) among labeled AUTO, Wilson 95% upper bound; unlabeled AUTO excluded and reported; LLM labels provisional
definitions.coverage: terms belonging to a merged group / all candidate terms; plus merged-group size distribution

hold.rule: HOLD = not merged automatically; not a required human queue
